text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up: prepping a lightweight playbook for the marketplace catalog push. Need final partner zips and confirmation on embargo decision by EOD Tue.
Priya Patel: Good call. Can we outline the absolute drop-dead cutoffs so partners know expectations?
Alex Kim: Drop-dead: assets in by Tue 23:59 PT, QA signoff Wed 11:00 PT, publish Fri 15:00 UTC. If partners miss Tue they go to the next batch (no exceptions unless sales escalates).
Samir Rao: If we get most zips on Mon evening we can run manifest validation at night and do a quick smoke Tue morning. That would give us a buffer for Wed QA.
Elena Martinez: I need staging preview URL + the exact UTM query string. Also need legal logo approval by Tue noon.
Alex Kim: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/catalog/preview/launch-rc2. UTM: utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=partner_launch_{partner}.
Priya Patel: Partner deliverables checklist (to share): 1) partner_asset.zip (logo SVG + PNG 150x150), 2) short 2-line description, 3) 1 customer quote or case blur, 4) SI manifest JSON, 5) support contact & regions.
Samir Rao: Sample SI manifest to validate ingestion (put this file at manifests/si.json inside the zip):
```
{
  "id": "partner-acme",
  "type": "service_integration",
  "regions": ["us-east-1","eu-central-1"],
  "support": "solutions@acme.com",
  "compat": ["redwood-runtime-v1","redwood-runtime-v2"]
}
```
Elena Martinez: Thanks. I'll QA the copy once zips land and will flag any branding/legal issues. @Alex please tag legal on the partner list.
Alex Kim: Tagged legal thread: legal-reviews@redwood. LaunchBot: dry-run deploy scheduled for Mon 09:30 UTC by Alex Kim.
Priya Patel: Embargo options: Fri 15:00 UTC (preferred) or Sat 03:00 UTC (for APAC-friendly timing). Thoughts?
Samir Rao: Friday keeps engineering support daylight-friendly for most regions. Let's pick Fri unless partner ops push back.
Elena Martinez: Agree on Fri. Also adding analytics event names to track: marketplace_partner_view, marketplace_partner_cta.
Samir Rao: I'll spin up a manifest validator and a bulk-check script. Will post URL here by Tue 19:00 UTC. Validator will check manifest schema + image sizes.
Alex Kim: Action items: Priya - final partner comms + embargo choice by EOD. Elena - QA copy & brand signoff Wed morning. Samir - validator + ingestion checklist. Everyone - ask partners for zips by Tue EOD.
Priya Patel: I'll send the partner email now with the checklist + a shared Google sheet for uploads. Will include "embargo fallback = next-weekend" language.
Elena Martinez: I'll reserve Wed 09:00-12:00 PT for QA. If dry-run goes well we can tighten to afternoon.
Samir Rao: Validator link (when ready): https://ci.redwood-inference.com/tools/si-validator. Script will return nonzero if a manifest fails.
Alex Kim: Also adding a tiny rollback plan: 1) unpublish catalog entry, 2) flip partner route to pre-existing landing, 3) notify partner + ops. Keep this in the playbook.
Priya Patel: Noted. I'll add rollback steps and escalation contacts to the sheet.
Elena Martinez: One more: please confirm which press author will own the PR and who will be CC'd from partner side. We should script the embargo email template too.
Alex Kim: I'll name the PR author by EOD. Will post the final runbook (single doc with links) here tonight. :thumbsup:
LaunchBot: Reminder: dry-run deploy in 6 days.
Priya Patel: If anyone wants a quick sync call Mon 08:30 UTC before dry-run, ping me and I'll set up a 20m.
Samir Rao: I'll join.
Elena Martinez: End thread - will use this as the canonical runbook link once assembled.
